# Familystyle Food

> > A culinary resource by Karen Tedesco featuring comfort food recipes, French cuisine, and shared plates inspired by her cookbook Family Style: Shared Plates for Casual Feasts.

Karen Tedesco is a cookbook author, recipe developer, and former Village Voice food writer based in New York City. The site showcases her approachable recipes for home cooks, with an emphasis on communal dining and classic comfort dishes.
